text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime p99 latency spike detected on prod-realtime (route: /v1/stream). p95 trending up. Thresholds breached: p99 > 1.5s, p95 > 300ms. Detected 2026-03-17T10:03:54Z. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/prod-realtime · Pager: oncall@sre · Incident ID: INC-3299001234

mia: Ack — paging oncall. I'm pulling up traces and kvcache metrics. @sam can you join? :eyes:

sam: Sam (oncall) here. Joining now. Looking at the dashboard: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms over last 4m, p99 at ~2.1s (baseline ~480ms). Error rate seems flat, but streaming stalls (server-side stalls) increased.

devon: Observing ingress queue depth rising on grpc-ingress shards. KV cache miss rate up ~12% over baseline. No recent infra deploys in last 30m.

lina: running quick trace sample for one stalled request, printing last spans:
```
trace_id=9f1c2a span=decode_tokens duration=110ms
trace_id=9f1c2a span=kvcache_lookup miss=true duration=45ms
trace_id=9f1c2a span=model_forward duration=1800ms status=ok
```

sam: model_forward 1800ms on p99 path — suggests model variant or kernel path causing tail. Any model rollouts?
devon: small config tweak to quantization/profile (opt-quant) for realtime models pushed ~8m ago by experiments team. Could be related.
mia: OK, quick mitigation plan: 1) shift 20% of /v1/stream traffic to fallback smaller model (fallback-v1) 2) bump autoscale min for realtime-pool from 4 -> 8 3) enable temporary KVcache warm on new nodes. Execute now?
sam: do it. I'll coordinate.

mia: running routing command: `rwdctl route split --route /v1/stream --variant fallback-v1 --percent 20`
(devon) scaling pool: `rwdctl pool update --name realtime-pool --min-instances 8`

lina: kicked cache warmers on new instances, warming key prefixes for active tenants.

lina: after 60s post-shift: p95 -> 260ms, p99 -> 920ms. KV miss rate down to +3% vs baseline.
sam: increase fallback to 50% while we confirm — doing: `rwdctl route split --route /v1/stream --variant fallback-v1 --percent 50`

devon: traffic shift and scale in effect. Observing ingress queue depth drop and model forward tail rates cut by ~60%.

incident-bot: Note recorded: oncall acknowledged, mitigation actions executed (route split + pool scale + cache warm).

mia: Customer impact note: transient streaming stalls >2s for some sessions between 10:00–10:12 UTC. No 5xx errors surfaced, sessions resumed. Likely affects subset of streaming beta tenants using opt-quant profile. Estimated affected sessions: ~0.3% of streaming traffic.
sam: current status: p95 ~150–220ms, p99 ~420–480ms, ingress queues normalized. Recommend holding fallback at 50% for 30m, then gradually roll back after post-checks. I'll open a follow-up incident ticket and assign postmortem to experiments team to revert or investigate opt-quant change.
devon: will also add short-term alert to detect KV miss spikes >8% for 5m.
mia: thanks everyone. I'll update customer-impact and create incident record INC-3299001234 with mitigation timeline.

sam: marking incident as mitigated and handing off to follow-up. Oncall clear in 10m unless regression. Good job. :thumbsup:

lina: adding trace snippets and logs to ticket.

mia: closing thread here — will link postmortem once created.
